source: Groove Monkee GM IOMap for SSD5.5 (community; https://groovemonkee.com/blogs/blog/how-to-use-the-free-version-of-ssd5-5)
notes: SSD5.5 is not native General MIDI. Load the Groove Monkee GM IOMap in SSD5.5's Map tab; this pass-through profile assumes that IOMap is active. Without it, GM notes will not trigger the expected pieces.
ui_hint: Load the Groove Monkee GM IOMap in SSD5.5's Map tab before playback.
